tasks.label: Compile and run
args: echo Compiling ${fileBasename}... && g++ "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" && echo Running program... && "${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" < "${fileDirname}\input.txt" > "${fileDirname}\output.txt" && echo Output saved to output.txt && type "${fileDirname}\output.txt" && del "${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe"
